blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Carlo Paalam expressed his frustrations after another narrow finals loss in the Asian Games 2026 men’s boxing 55kg, saying he felt his momentum was repeatedly disrupted during the fight. Paalam settled for silver, the Philippine boxing team’s lone medal in Aichi-Nagoya, after losing to Japan’s Rui Yamaguchi by split decision at Nishio Gymnasium on Friday. Paalam said repeated stoppages by Uzbek referee Maruf Urdushev disrupted his rhythm, particularly when he felt he was building momentum. “I felt good, but again, the referee.
